protocol.assembly: Compare inner loops, vector width, spills, calls, branches, and multiplication/addition counts. No microarchitectural cycle claim without measurement.
candidates: Runtime-guarded AVX dense tiles: independent output lanes, same ordered multiplies/adds, no FMA; portable fallback
Memoize attention exponentials in FP64 scratch; identical reduction and division, bounded workspace increase
protocol.gate: Median paired last/batch1 p50 improvement >=5%; each seed improves; median paired p99 regression <=10%; batch8 and full-trace median paired p50 regressions <=5%; report all cells and outliers
protocol.inputs: Unchanged 32 validation windows and saved models from latest_v1
limitations: Local Intel Mac, uncontrolled OS/cache/frequency; no hard deadline or current-runtime frontier claim
Profile samples identify work; only separate uninstrumented runs establish measured latency
Development candidates may be rejected; all trials and failed candidates retained
protocol.numerical: Existing outputs and failure semantics unchanged. Bitwise saved full traces and every prefix; unchanged independent-reference tolerance. No fast-math, quantization or model change.
protocol.order: Fresh serial process per cell; alternate baseline/candidate by trial, seed, batch and mode; no simultaneous benchmarking
protocol.purpose: Assembly-guided incremental optimization on the local Intel Mac; Linux performance deferred
protocol.selection: Evaluate each candidate separately. Retain only candidates passing the unchanged >=5% primary end-to-end gate, parity and safety checks. Report rejection as well as acceptance.

decisions.avx_initial: Retain, then narrow dispatch after shape diagnostic
